questions.prompt: Azithromycin is frequently used to treat atypical pneumonia caused by Mycoplasma pneumoniae. Which of the following best describes its primary mechanism of action?
options: Inhibition of cell wall peptidoglycan synthesis
Binding to the 30S ribosomal subunit to block mRNA translation
Inhibition of DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV
Prevention of polypeptide elongation at the 50S ribosome
Disruption of the bacterial cell membrane integrity
